dsparkDescription: Kubaka nduku ya DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) sambu na LFM2.5-2.6B. Yau lenda sala nswalu, kansi yau kesadilaka RAM to VRAM yankaka, yau kebikaka memori fyoti sambu na mambu yina kele na kati. Meka yo na bima na nge; kuyidika nda ya mambu to kukanga decodage ya luvunu na baparametre ya mbandu.
